description: This file defines internal interfaces, data structures, and a class for managing the migration of grain activations between silos in Orleans. It includes mechanisms for accepting migration requests, performing asynchronous migration operations, handling cluster membership updates, and managing migration work queues.

classes.name: ActivationMigrationManager
classes.description: Manages the migration of grain activations across silos, including handling migration requests, processing cluster membership updates, and coordinating migration work queues.

classes.name: MigrationWorkItem
classes.description: Represents a unit of migration work for a grain activation, supporting asynchronous completion and exception handling.

methods.name: AcceptMigratingGrains
methods.description: Accepts a list of migrating grain packages and ensures their activations are created and in a valid state.

methods.name: MigrateAsync
methods.description: Initiates migration of a specific grain to a target silo asynchronously.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Continuously processes cluster membership updates to manage migration worker lifecycles.

methods.name: PumpMigrationQueue
methods.description: Processes migration work items for a specific target silo, batching and sending them for migration.

methods.name: GetOrCreateWorker
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a migration worker channel and task for a target silo.

methods.name: RemoveWorker
methods.description: Removes and cleans up a migration worker for a target silo.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Placeholder for startup logic, currently completes immediately.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down all migration workers and cancels ongoing operations.
